messages.subject: Project Mallory — draft standstill agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Olivia,

Following the meeting, I attach our first draft of the standstill and reservation of rights agreement for Sterling's review. Key points: standstill period to 31 March 2026; acknowledgement of the specified defaults and £41.75m outstanding; undertakings to deliver the final IBR by 19 December and a weekly 13-week cashflow. We've left the fee/cost recovery wording for you to confirm.

Grateful for a quick turn given the board has approved signing this week.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0021

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged. If you are not the intended recipient please notify the sender and delete it.

messages.subject: RE: Project Mallory — draft standstill agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. The bank is broadly content. Two points: (1) the IBR delivery date should be 19 December as drafted — agreed; (2) please add an express termination event if any new financial indebtedness is incurred outside trade credit, and confirm the cost-recovery clause covers our fees whether or not the restructuring completes. With those changes we can sign on 5 December.

Olivia Marsh
Partner | Drummond Hale LLP
